summary: A treatise on soul blows that leave an ache trailing the target's thoughts long after the strike has passed.

summary: A primer on finding the seams of a soul and tearing along them with a sharpened edge of force.

summary: A course in loosing many small darts of soul force at once and aiming each at a different weak point.
